# List of numerical variables
numeric_vars <- c("BMI", "SleepTime")

# Function to remove outliers using IQR
remove_outliers <- function(data, column) {
  Q1 <- quantile(data[[column]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)  # 25 percentile
  Q3 <- quantile(data[[column]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)  # 75 percentile
  IQR_value <- Q3 - Q1

  # Lower and upper bounds
  lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
  upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value

  # Filter out outliers
  data <- data[data[[column]] >= lower_bound & data[[column]] <= upper_bound, ]
  return(data)
}

# Apply outlier removal for each numeric variable
for (var in numeric_vars) {
  heartriskData <- remove_outliers(heartriskData, var)
}

library(caret)
## Loading required package: lattice
## 
## Attaching package: 'caret'
## The following object is masked from 'package:purrr':
## 
##     lift
set.seed(123)

# Create a partition: 80% training, 20% testing
train_index <- createDataPartition(heartriskData$HeartDisease, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

# Split data
train_data <- heartriskData[train_index, ]
test_data <- heartriskData[-train_index, ]

# Print the number of records in each set
cat("Training Set:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
## Training Set: 110963
cat("Testing Set:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
## Testing Set: 27739
#Logistic regression - for all predictors
logistic1 <- glm(HeartDisease ~ ., data = train_data, family = binomial)

#Balancing the Dataset

# install.packages("ROSE")
library(ROSE)
## Loaded ROSE 0.0-4
# Oversample the minority class
balanced_data <- ROSE(HeartDisease ~ ., data = heartriskData, seed = 123)$data

# Check the new class distribution
table(balanced_data$HeartDisease)
## 
##    No   Yes 
## 69564 69138

#Normalization

# Function to normalize numerical variables
normalize <- function(x) {
  return((x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
}

# Apply normalization to numerical variables
numeric_vars <- c("BMI", "PhysicalHealth", "MentalHealth", "SleepTime")
balanced_data[numeric_vars] <- lapply(balanced_data[numeric_vars], normalize)

# Check summary statistics after normalization
summary(balanced_data[numeric_vars])
##       BMI         PhysicalHealth    MentalHealth      SleepTime     
##  Min.   :0.0000   Min.   :0.0000   Min.   :0.0000   Min.   :0.0000  
##  1st Qu.:0.3858   1st Qu.:0.2506   1st Qu.:0.1879   1st Qu.:0.4316  
##  Median :0.4703   Median :0.2815   Median :0.2222   Median :0.5258  
##  Mean   :0.4844   Mean   :0.3459   Mean   :0.2772   Mean   :0.5193  
##  3rd Qu.:0.5706   3rd Qu.:0.3517   3rd Qu.:0.2810   3rd Qu.:0.6091  
##  Max.   :1.0000   Max.   :1.0000   Max.   :1.0000   Max.   :1.0000

#Updated Data Partitioning

set.seed(123)

# Create a partition: 80% training, 20% testing
train_index <- createDataPartition(balanced_data$HeartDisease, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

# Split data
train_data <- balanced_data[train_index, ]
test_data <- balanced_data[-train_index, ]

# Print the number of records in each set
cat("Training Set:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
## Training Set: 110963
cat("Testing Set:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
## Testing Set: 27739

#Logistic Regression with Balanced Data

# Logistic regression - for all predictors
logistic2 <- glm(HeartDisease ~ ., data = train_data, family = binomial)
summary(logistic2)

# Predict probabilities
pred_probs <- predict(logistic2, newdata = test_data, type = "response")

# Convert probabilities to class labels (threshold = 0.5 by default)
pred_classes <- ifelse(pred_probs > 0.5, "Yes", "No")  # Adjust based on your factor levels
pred_classes <- factor(pred_classes, levels = levels(test_data$HeartDisease))

library(caret)
confusionMatrix(pred_classes, test_data$HeartDisease)

dummies_model <- dummyVars(HeartDisease ~ ., data = balanced_data)
dummy_data <- data.frame(predict(dummies_model, newdata = balanced_data))
## Warning in model.frame.default(Terms, newdata, na.action = na.action, xlev =
## object$lvls): variable 'HeartDisease' is not a factor
# Add target back
dummy_data$HeartDisease <- balanced_data$HeartDisease

# Normalize numeric columns again just in case
normalize <- function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
dummy_data[] <- lapply(dummy_data, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) normalize(x) else x)

# Partition data
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(dummy_data$HeartDisease, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_nn <- dummy_data[train_idx, ]
test_nn <- dummy_data[-train_idx, ]
# Convert target to binary (0 = No, 1 = Yes)
train_nn$HeartDisease <- ifelse(train_nn$HeartDisease == "Yes", 1, 0)
test_nn$HeartDisease <- ifelse(test_nn$HeartDisease == "Yes", 1, 0)

# Fit neural network model (single hidden layer with 5 neurons)
set.seed(123)
nn_model <- nnet(HeartDisease ~ ., data = train_nn, size = 5, maxit = 200, decay = 5e-4, linout = FALSE)
## # weights:  261
## initial  value 27755.142690 
## iter  10 value 18158.127501
## iter  20 value 17657.883296
## iter  30 value 17597.764382
## iter  40 value 17545.848067
## iter  50 value 17500.383096

## iter 100 value 17219.755214
## iter 110 value 17187.106454
## iter 120 value 17148.220121
## iter 130 value 17130.092160
## iter 140 value 17118.661641
## iter 150 value 17106.925398
## iter 160 value 17071.749466
## iter 170 value 17058.680286
## iter 180 value 17053.164953
## iter 190 value 17045.868848
## iter 200 value 17036.933235
## final  value 17036.933235 
## stopped after 200 iterations
# Predict on test set
nn_preds <- predict(nn_model, test_nn[, -ncol(test_nn)], type = "raw")
nn_classes <- ifelse(nn_preds > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Evaluation
confusionMatrix(factor(nn_classes), factor(test_nn$HeartDisease))

##    Detection Prevalence : 0.4677          
##       Balanced Accuracy : 0.7775          
##                                           
##        'Positive' Class : 0               
## 
# ROC & AUC
library(pROC)
nn_roc <- roc(test_nn$HeartDisease, nn_preds)
## Setting levels: control = 0, case = 1
## Warning in roc.default(test_nn$HeartDisease, nn_preds): Deprecated use a matrix
## as predictor. Unexpected results may be produced, please pass a numeric vector.
## Setting direction: controls < cases
plot(nn_roc, col = "purple", main = "Neural Network ROC Curve")

auc(nn_roc)
## Area under the curve: 0.8547
small_train <- train_nn[, c("BMI", "SleepTime", "PhysicalHealth", "MentalHealth", "HeartDisease")]
small_test <- test_nn[, c("BMI", "SleepTime", "PhysicalHealth", "MentalHealth", "HeartDisease")]

# Normalize and sample
small_train$HeartDisease <- as.numeric(small_train$HeartDisease)
small_train_norm <- as.data.frame(lapply(small_train, function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))))
small_sample <- small_train_norm[sample(1:nrow(small_train_norm), 200), ]

# Formula
nn_formula <- as.formula("HeartDisease ~ BMI + SleepTime + PhysicalHealth + MentalHealth")

# Train neural network (with stepmax)
set.seed(123)
nn_vis <- neuralnet(nn_formula, data = small_sample, hidden = 3, linear.output = FALSE, stepmax = 5e4)

# Plot
plot(nn_vis)
small_train <- train_nn[, c("BMI", "SleepTime", "PhysicalHealth", "MentalHealth", "HeartDisease")]
small_test <- test_nn[, c("BMI", "SleepTime", "PhysicalHealth", "MentalHealth", "HeartDisease")]

print(nn_vis$result.matrix)  # Shows error, steps, etc.
##                                     [,1]
## error                       1.805940e+01
## reached.threshold           9.919835e-03

## SleepTime.to.1layhid2       3.827519e+00

## 1layhid2.to.HeartDisease   -7.821520e+00
## 1layhid3.to.HeartDisease    6.057191e+00
pred_nn <- compute(nn_vis, small_test[, c("BMI", "SleepTime", "PhysicalHealth", "MentalHealth")])
pred_values <- ifelse(pred_nn$net.result > 0.5, 1, 0)


actual <- small_test$HeartDisease
mean(pred_values == actual)

#install.packages("xgboost", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org/")

library(xgboost)
## 
## Attaching package: 'xgboost'
## The following object is masked from 'package:dplyr':
## 
##     slice
# Prepare data
train_xgb <- train_data
test_xgb <- test_data

# Convert factors to dummy variables (one-hot encoding)
train_matrix <- model.matrix(HeartDisease ~ . -1, data = train_xgb)
test_matrix <- model.matrix(HeartDisease ~ . -1, data = test_xgb)

# Create labels
train_label <- as.numeric(train_xgb$HeartDisease) - 1  # Ensure labels are 0 and 1
test_label <- as.numeric(test_xgb$HeartDisease) - 1

# Create DMatrix
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = train_matrix, label = train_label)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = test_matrix, label = test_label)

# Train XGBoost
xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = dtest,
  max.depth = 4,
  eta = 0.1,
  nrounds = 100,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  verbose = 0
)

# Predict
xgb_pred <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)
xgb_class <- ifelse(xgb_pred > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Evaluate AUC
library(pROC)
xgb_roc <- roc(test_label, xgb_pred)
## Setting levels: control = 0, case = 1
## Setting direction: controls < cases
auc(xgb_roc)
## Area under the curve: 0.8924
# Assuming your predictions (xgb_class or model predictions) are stored in xgb_class
# and your true labels (test_label) are stored in test_label

# Calculate the number of correct predictions
correct_predictions <- sum(xgb_class == test_label)

# Calculate accuracy
accuracy <- correct_predictions / length(test_label)

# Print accuracy
print(paste("Accuracy:", round(accuracy * 100, 2), "%"))

library(randomForest)

library(pROC)

# Predict probabilities
test_data$pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")[, 2]
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(risk_group = case_when(
    pred_prob >= 0.85 ~ "High Risk",
    pred_prob >= 0.5 & pred_prob < 0.85 ~ "Medium Risk",
    pred_prob < 0.5 ~ "Low Risk"
  )) %>%
  mutate(risk_group = factor(risk_group, levels = c("Low Risk", "Medium Risk", "High Risk")))
test_data %>%
  group_by(risk_group) %>%
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_mean"),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_sd")
  )
